Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the northbound frontage road in Conroe, Texas, waiting for traffic to clear,
when Driver 2 approached from behind and struck the rear of the vehicle. Driver 2 stated that he was looking down at
a phone and did not notice the stopped traffic until it was too late to brake. The impact psuhed Driver 1's vehicle
forward into the lane ahead, and the rear bumper and trunk lid show crush damage that is consistent with the force
described at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain immediately after the collision and was assisted from
the vehicle by responding units. A Passenger seated in the front right seat was also present and was confirmed by
responding officers as being in the vehicle at the time of impact. Witnesses in a nearby vehicle gave statements that
matched the sequence reported by both drivers, and scene photographs support their accounts. Some old scratches
were noted on the lower rear bumper, which may predate this collision and were recorded for reference only. Driver 1
is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the time of the crash.
